title: Single-Loop Penalty Methods for Bilevel Reinforcement Learning

contributions.purpose: 去掉惩罚型双层RL的内层best-response oracle
contributions.mechanism: PBRL-SL:每步一次mirror-descent/PG跟踪follower最优策略 + Lyapunov吸收梯度偏差(仅Bellman惩罚)
contributions.evaluation: 定性(纯理论);声称去掉内层对数因子,wall-clock快5-10x(无实验佐证)
contributions.source_quote: We present PBRL-SL, a single-loop penalty method that dispenses with the inner oracle.

contributions.purpose: 证明单层法保持原收敛阶
contributions.mechanism: Lyapunov(惩罚目标+跟踪误差平方)descent + 步长平衡contraction/drift
contributions.evaluation: 投影梯度平稳性 Õ(λε⁻²),迭代复杂度 K=Θ̃(λε⁻²),与双层法同阶(定理1,仅证明草图)
contributions.source_quote: Under Assumptions 3.1-3.2 ... PBRL-SL achieves Õ(λε⁻²) projected-gradient stationarity, matching prior iteration order while being simpler to implement.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our method builds on their penalty philosophy but removes the inner oracle via tracking and Lyapunov absorption.

(8) developed a principled penalty-based framework specifically for bilevel RL and RLHF ... However, their algorithms remain double-loop: each outer step calls a best-response oracle for the lower policy. By contrast, our PBRL-SL algorithm follows only one policy-gradient/mirror-descent step per outer iteration.

notes: 纯理论论文,无任何实验(reproducibility/实验类checklist全填NA)。数据红旗:3.2与3.3两节标题完全相同("Penalty functions: self-contained recap")且正文逐字重复(value/Bellman penalty整段复制),疑似生成/排版重复。非实证适配问题:摘要与讨论声称单层法"5-10x lower in wall-clock",但全文无实验支撑,属未验证经验性声明。checklist AI自我披露:四项全 [D](AI-generated,>95%);Observed AI Limitation自述"A good hypothesis is very important, but it is difficult for AI to generate."。无自声明编号贡献列表,由abstract+intro+conclusion归纳为2条。
